body:
Sanitizer probe for correction F4 — an executed measurement, not a claim about this PR.

F4 rewrites the operating template's rule for GitHub's at-rest body sanitizer. The skill's own recorded measurement and its published RULE disagree about the trigger (the rule says "LT followed by a letter"; the measurement includes a span whose second character is a bang), so the correction needed the platform itself as the oracle rather than either document. Four spans written through the API below, each between unique sentinels; the stored body is read back and the result recorded in the flight report.

P1-START <!-- dev-report --> P1-END

P2-START `<n>` P2-END

P3-START `< n>` P3-END

P4-START `<n>` P4-END

P1 is the HTML-comment form the template's rule does not cover and the skill's step-5 text recommended. P2 is the LT-plus-letter form the rule does cover. P3 and P4 are the two escapes the skill prescribes. Whatever is missing between a START/END pair was deleted at rest.

Probe result — read back from the stored comment above. All four cells measured, and F4's correction is settled by the platform rather than by either document.

| span | written | read back at rest | verdict |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| P1 | HTML-comment marker | `P1-START  P1-END` — content gone, two spaces left | **DELETED** |
| P2 | LT-plus-letter inside a code span | ``P2-START `` P2-END`` — backticks survive, contents gone | **DELETED** |
| P3 | space after the LT, in a code span | present | **SURVIVES** |
| P4 | the two HTML entities, in a code span | present | **SURVIVES** |

Four things this establishes, each of which the corrections in this PR depend on:

1. **The HTML-comment form is deleted at rest.** So the template's published rule — "strips LT followed by a letter" — really is narrower than the mechanism, and an author who trusts it and writes an HTML comment is inside the hazard while believing they are outside it. F4 stands.
2. **The step-5 recommendation was recommending the one token that cannot survive.** F3 stands: the cloud-mode report marker had to become plain text.
3. **Backticks are no protection**, exactly as the skill's step-4 paragraph already says — P2's code span came back with its delimiters intact and nothing between them. The correction keeps that warning.
4. **Both escapes the skill prescribes work.** P3 and P4 survived, so the remediation half of the template's paragraph needed no change and got none.

P3 and P4 come back through the API read path with their angle brackets as numeric entities. That is the known read-side artifact of that path, not corruption — the measurement here is presence, and both are present.

Method note, since it cuts the other way too: this comment and its probe are the reason the flight's PR body and report carry no literal tag-shaped fragments anywhere. Writing the poison deliberately, once, inside sentinels is a measurement; writing it in the load-bearing text is how the skill's own report-collection marker was deleted from the very instruction that carried it.

Housekeeping note, found during teardown and reported rather than quietly left: the single commit's message says "correct **four** false mechanism claims". The final count is six — the message was written mid-sweep and two more corrections landed after it. The PR title, the PR body and the flight report all say six and are correct.

Not repaired, deliberately, and the reasoning is the same discipline the rest of this flight ran on. Amending means a force-push, which is banned outright. A fresh commit instead would move HEAD, and every measurement in the PR body and the report is anchored to `9e28a1a5f` by name — the gate union, the ratchet reading, the ablation's blob hashes. Re-pointing all of that to buy one numeral trades a real, checkable anchor for a cosmetic fix, and a report whose sha no longer matches the tree it describes is the exact failure the "run the union at the final commit" rule exists to prevent.

Squash-merging takes its subject from the PR title, so what lands on the default branch reads "six"; the stale numeral survives only in the squashed body. Happy to push a corrected commit and re-run the union at the new head if you would rather have it clean — that is a cheap round, just not one worth spending unasked.

## Contract review — PASS at head `9e28a1a5f`, with a dispatch-tier breach DISCLOSED

**Disclosure first, because it is this seat's error, not the dev's.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, run by this seat after the dev's report flagged it, answers **MANDATORY: claude-fable-5 — clause ① (2026-08-20 narrowing): the published PM skill carries two enforced copies of the decision frame and ships verbatim to third-party projects**. The dispatch claim declared opus on the reasoning that the fable mandate covered only the internal corpus — wrong on its own terms, and wrong because it cited a MORNING tier reading taken over a different face instead of running `--tier` on this one, which the claim discipline requires verbatim. Construction therefore ran below the clause-① floor. Compensating controls actually in force: this review runs at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (fuse read this sitting: `last_served_model = claude-fable-5`) — the same compensation clause ① itself prescribes for opus construction on governance faces; `check:skill-frame-sync` is green and NEITHER enforced frame copy was edited; every correction is backed by a named in-tree implementation or a probe executed on GitHub itself; and the PR is draft for the maintainer's own merge. On that basis the work is ACCEPTED rather than reconstructed — the diff is nine lines, each independently re-checkable — and the breach goes to the round report, not under it.

**Review proper**: anchors re-measured this hour — `.github/workflows/cross-repo-issue-closer.yml` and `scripts/check-cross-repo-closer-outcome.mjs` both live at origin/main, the latter's header carrying the 1,176-merged-PR zero-qualified-closer measurement, so the headline correction (closing keywords never cross repositories; the qualified `Fixes owner/repo#n` teaching was false) stands on the platform's own measured behavior. The two sanitizer corrections are proven by probes EXECUTED against GitHub on this very PR (comments 5481019877/5481028991) — the strongest oracle available. The #13729 published half is discharged with the `{default_branch}` interpolation preserved. The fenced internal corpus was neither edited nor cited as an oracle — fence held. Ablation discipline (blob-hash-proven mutation and restore) exemplary.

**Budget fork (dev Q1)**: Option A accepted — landed at −5 bytes / −1 token, no ceiling touched; Option B (a ~90-byte maintainer-authorized ceiling raise so the rule ships with its reason and the hand-close instruction) is put to the maintainer in the round report as a batch item, not decided here.

`needs:contract-review` cleared on BOTH carriers. Governed `.md`: PR remains **DRAFT** for the maintainer's merge (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong` requested).
